lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Three levels of drums. From your first beat... to absolute chaos. Let's go.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level one. Easy. The basic rock beat. Hi-hat, kick, snare. Every song you know starts here.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level two. Medium. A funk groove. Sixteenth notes on the hi-hat, quiet ghost notes on the snare, and fills around the toms.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Level three. Hard. One hundred and sixty eight beats per minute. Double kick, blast beats, and a drum solo. Up to twenty seven hits... every second.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: That's all three levels. Which one can you play? Tell me in the comments.
